title: HPE Q2 FY26 Earnings: AI Demand Drives Record Backlog & Guidance Raise
description: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) reported a strong Q2 FY26, with revenue up 40% year-on-year to $10.7 billion, significantly beating estimates. Non-GAAP dilut.

faq.q: What caused HPE stock to surge after its Q2 FY26 earnings?
faq.a: HPE's stock surged because the company reported significantly better-than-expected revenue and earnings, driven by strong demand for AI infrastructure and networking solutions. They also raised their full-year guidance substantially, indicating strong future prospects.

faq.q: How much did HPE's revenue grow in Q2 FY26?
faq.a: HPE reported total revenue of $10.7 billion for Q2 FY26, which is a 40% increase compared to the same period last year.

faq.q: What was the key driver for HPE's strong performance?
faq.a: The key drivers were robust demand across its portfolio, particularly in the Networking segment (up 148.2%) and the Cloud & AI segment (up 22.9%), with strong orders for servers related to AI inferencing.

faq.q: Did HPE raise its guidance for the full fiscal year 2026?
faq.a: Yes, HPE significantly raised its FY26 guidance. They now expect revenue growth of 29% to 33% and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $3.35 to $3.45, effectively pulling forward their FY28 targets to FY26.

faq.q: What is a "record backlog" and why is it important?
faq.a: A "record backlog" means the company has a historically high amount of confirmed orders for products or services that are yet to be delivered and recognised as revenue. It's important because it provides strong visibility into future revenue generation and indicates sustained demand.

faq.q: How did HPE's cash flow perform this quarter?
faq.a: HPE generated $1.4 billion in cash from operating activities and a record $915 million in free cash flow for Q2 FY26, a significant increase from the prior year.

faq.q: What was the impact of the Juniper Networks acquisition?
faq.a: The Juniper Networks acquisition contributed to the substantial 148.2% surge in HPE's Networking revenue, enhancing its capabilities and market share in this high-demand area.
